//goldenSuite: server/tests/golden.test.js — one test per lesson that cost something. Organised by incident, not by module. Never skips: no database, no network, no model. Entries are only ever added. GOLDEN-001 (tenant isolation, 3), GOLDEN-002 (test-database separation, 3), GOLDEN-003 (tool refusal retry loop, 1), GOLDEN-004 (test-database redirect defeated by require order, 1), GOLDEN-005 (SPA fallback swallowing published pharmacy websites: 005 and 005b for the /p/ path form, 005c for the <address>.rxnaija.com host form, 3), GOLDEN-006 (health check restarting the process on a database blip, 1). 12 tests. Added 2026-08-29, extended 2026-09-05 and 2026-09-06.
//lastChange: Pharmacy websites answer on their own hostname (2026-09-06). resolveSiteKey already preferred the host, but the router was mounted only at /p — so <address>.rxnaija.com/ had path "/", matched nothing, and fell to the SPA fallback, which would have served the DASHBOARD SHELL at 200 to every pharmacy customer and to Google. The same failure GOLDEN-005 exists to prevent, reached by the other shape; GOLDEN-005c now covers it, and was verified to fail when the bug is reintroduced. Certificates are issued on demand behind /api/internal/tls-ask, because a wildcard DNS record otherwise lets a stranger burn a weekly issuance limit counted against the whole registered domain. Measured after: 1405/956/442/7, +10 all database-free.
